name: unifi-drive
description: UniFi Drive MCP server — read NAS storage pools, disk health and shared drives, and manage file services and NFS clients

interface.shortDescription: Read UniFi NAS storage health and manage file sharing
interface.longDescription: Read storage pools, RAID state, disk SMART health and shared drives on a UniFi NAS (UNAS), turn SMB, NFS or Time Machine on or off, and manage NFS client connections, each write previewed before it runs. Connects to the NAS itself with a local UniFi OS account.
